title: Termwise coefficient complex diagram and colimit comparison
statement: Fix a scheme X in universe u, a prime ℓ, finite intermediate fields E and F of the algebraic closure of Q_ℓ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], and a cochain complex C of internal F_X-modules [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let I be a small filtered category in universe u+1, H : I → FiniteIntermediateField(ℓ) a final functor, and he : E ≤ H(i), hf : F ≤ H(i) for every i. There exist a diagram N of complexes of E_X-modules and a colimit cocone c whose object N(i) is exactly the termwise extension of C from F_X to H(i)_X followed by restriction to E_X. There are isomorphisms Q(c.pt) ≅ U_{Ω,E}T_{F,Ω}Q(C) and Q(N(i)) ≅ U_{H(i),E}T_{F,H(i)}Q(C). For each i, the fixed finite adjunction transposes the stage comparison Q(N(i)) → U_{H(i),E}T_{F,H(i)}Q(C). Extending this transpose to Ω, conjugating by the fixed tensor comparisons, and transposing under the fixed Ω-adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison] gives exactly Q(c.ι_i) followed by the vertex comparison. This equation is only for the canonical cocone arrow, with source Q(N(i)); arbitrary source objects and precomposition morphisms are handled by the parent proof. Here Ω uses finite-subfield-valued functions. C need not be bounded in either direction, and this statement asserts no bound or derived-category representative choice.

The explicit coefficient cocone is a colimit by the balanced-tensor coequalizer argument carried out degreewise.
Take coefficientComplexVertexIso and coefficientComplexStageIso as the comparison isomorphisms. Apply the single-stage derived compatibility identity separately to each object of H.

theorem exists_condensed_coefficient_complex_model
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E F : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (C : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ F)) ℤ)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (H : I ⥤ FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) [H.Final]
    (he : ∀ i, E ≤ H.obj i) (hf : ∀ i, F ≤ H.obj i) :
    ∃ N : I ⥤ CochainComplex
        (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ E)) ℤ,
      ∃ c : Cocone N, Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
      (∀ i, N.obj i =
        (((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjMap X ℓ (hf i))) ⋙
          Mod.comap (padicSubfieldRingObjMap X ℓ (he i))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj C) ∧
      ∃ eΩ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt ≅
          (finiteCoefficientDerivedFromAlgCl X ℓ E).obj
            ((finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ F).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
        ∃ ei : ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj i) ≅
            (finiteCoefficientDerivedRestriction X ℓ (he i)).obj
              ((finiteCoefficientDerivedExtension X ℓ (hf i)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)),
          ∀ i : I,
            finiteCoefficientDerivedAlgClHomEquiv X ℓ E
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj i)) _
              ((finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ (he i)).inv.app
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj i)) ≫
                (finiteCoefficientDerivedToAlgCl X ℓ (H.obj i)).map
                    ((finiteCoefficientDerivedHomEquiv X ℓ (he i)
                        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj i)) _).symm (ei i).hom) ≫
                  (finiteCoefficientDerivedTensorCompIso X ℓ (hf i)).hom.app
                    (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) =
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.ι.app i) ≫ eΩ.hom
